title: The Phantom Village of Kuldhara
hook: In a single night in 1825, over eight hundred people vanished from a bustling desert town without leaving a single footprint, abandoning their home to an eternal curse.

scenes.narration: Deep in the Thar Desert of India lie the crumbling sandstone ruins of Kuldhara. For centuries, it was a prosperous settlement of the Paliwal Brahmins. But today, it stands as a dead silence in the burning sands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic drone shot descending over vast, abandoned ancient sandstone village ruins in a barren desert during golden hour.

scenes.narration: Legend tells of a tyrannical minister who lusted after the village chief's daughter. He gave the elders an ultimatum: hand her over by the next dawn, or face unimaginable violence.
scenes.visual_prompt: Dramatic macro shot of dusty vintage oil lamps flickering against dark carved wooden doors in a shadowy ancient courtyard.

scenes.narration: Instead of submitting, the entire population of eighty-five neighboring hamlets packed what little they could carry and vanished into the night. When the sun rose, not a single soul remained.
scenes.visual_prompt: Eerie atmospheric shot of wind whipping sand through deserted, windowless stone doorways under a starless twilight sky.

scenes.narration: Before leaving, they cast a powerful curse upon the land: anyone who attempted to inhabit Kuldhara would perish. To this day, the mystery of where they went remains unsolved, and the ruins remain completely deserted.
scenes.visual_prompt: Slow-motion panning shot of modern paranormal investigators walking through shadowy ruins as dusk turns to pitch darkness.
